latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Tides skill with global ocean tides API access.

- Provides JSON-RPC API for querying tide heights, tide extrema, and grid weather data worldwide.
- Supports free (anonymous) and token-authenticated (keyed) access tiers.
- Full documentation with usage patterns, authentication options, and example curl commands.
- Error handling and standardized JSON-RPC response formats included.
